Interacting with the canvas by pressing the mouse activates or alters the ongoing celestial display.

statement: This sketch renders a dynamic, three-dimensional solar system using p5.js's WEBGL renderer. It features a central sun with glowing light, eight orbiting planets with distinct colors and sizes, and some planets adorned with rings. Each planet follows an elliptical path around the sun, with orbits traced by faint light trails. The entire scene rotates slowly to provide a full view of the system. A click interaction toggles the animation on and off, allowing viewers to pause and examine the structure at any moment. The visualization emphasizes both celestial motion and the beauty of cosmic scale through lighting effects and smooth orbital mechanics.
